name: caveman
title: Caveman Mode
summary: Terse high-signal response protocol for coding agents that minimizes tokens without losing correctness, safety, or execution clarity.

use_when: User wants terse, low-token, high-signal technical replies
Debugging, PR review, diff summaries, or triage need compression
Agent-to-agent handoff or status updates should stay compact
avoid_when: User needs tutorial-style explanation, onboarding, or polished prose
High-risk instructions need explicit detail before compression
Task is bulk code generation or writing large new code, documentation, commit messages, or PR titles
